Attractive 2-Bedroom Red Brick Town House in the Heart of Mullingar

Price: €249,950

Town Centre Living at Its Best

Ideally positioned on the ever-popular Austin Friar Street, 4 Bellview Terrace presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a beautifully refurbished two-bedroom red brick townhouse in one of Mullingar's most convenient residential locations.
Within a short stroll of Mullingar's vibrant town centre, the property enjoys immediate access to an excellent range of amenities including shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, supermarkets, pharmacies, churches, leisure facilities, and public transport. Mullingar Train Station and bus services are within walking distance, while the N4 and N52 road networks provide easy commuting to Dublin, Galway and surrounding counties.
Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizer or investor, this immaculate home combines character, comfort and convenience in an exceptional town centre setting.

Outstanding Mullingar Town Centre Location

Living at Bellview Terrace means everything Mullingar has to offer is just moments from your doorstep.
Enjoy easy access to:
•	Mullingar's excellent selection of shops and boutiques
•	Supermarkets including Tesco, Dunnes Stores, Lidl and Aldi
•	Award-winning cafés, restaurants and traditional pubs
•	Mullingar Train Station with regular services to Dublin and Sligo
•	National and secondary schools
•	Midland Regional Hospital Mullingar
•	Sports clubs, gyms and leisure facilities
•	Nearby parks and scenic walks
•	Excellent road connectivity via the N4 and N52
This superb central location offers the perfect balance of convenience, lifestyle and connectivity, making it an ideal place to call home.
________________________________________


A Home Ready to Move Into
Finished to an excellent standard throughout, this attractive townhouse offers bright, comfortable accommodation together with a generous rear garden—an increasingly rare feature for a town centre property. Its immaculate presentation means the successful purchaser can move in immediately and enjoy all the benefits of modern town living.

•	Attractive two-storey red brick townhouse
•	2 spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
•	Bright lounge with polished timber flooring and solid fuel stove
•	Modern fitted kitchen with integrated appliances

•	Contemporary bathroom with electric shower
